# Setup

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(tidyverse)
library(jsonlite)
library(here)
```

# Load data

```{r}
#| message: false
data_path <- "/Users/apple/Desktop/UCSD/kids-network/exp0/data"

all_data <- list.files(data_path, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE) %>%
  map_dfr(~ read_csv(.x, col_types = cols(.default = "c")))
```

# Normalize participant IDs

```{r}
# clean participant ID
all_data <- all_data %>%
  mutate(
    participant_id = participant_id %>%
      as.character() %>%
      str_extract("\\d+") %>%               
      str_pad(width = 3, pad = "0") %>%      
      paste0("p", .)                       
  )
```

# Filter to grid trials

```{r}
# filter for relevant trials
grid_trials <- all_data %>%
  filter(trial_type == "emotion-grid",
         !is.na(block), block != "null")
```

```{r}
all_data %>%
  filter(trial_type == "emotion-grid", !is.na(block), block != "null") %>%
  mutate(
    has_move_log   = !is.na(move_log)   & move_log   != "[]",
    has_placements = !is.na(placements) & placements != "[]"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::count(participant_id, has_move_log, has_placements) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(participant_id) %>%
  print(n = Inf)
```

# Reconstruct final image placements from move log

```{r}
#function for extracting final placements
#future data should contain a placement column
extract_final_placements <- function(row) {

  if (is.na(row$move_log) || row$move_log == "[]") return(NULL)

  parsed <- tryCatch(fromJSON(row$move_log), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(parsed)) return(NULL)

  # Must have grid positions
  if (!all(c("grid_col", "grid_row") %in% names(parsed))) return(NULL)

  # Detect image-name column (varies across versions)
  img_col <- if ("image_name" %in% names(parsed)) "image_name"
             else if ("image" %in% names(parsed)) "image"
             else return(NULL)

  result <- parsed %>%
    mutate(
      grid_col = as.numeric(grid_col),
      grid_row = as.numeric(grid_row)
    )

  # If timestamps exist, keep only the last placement per image
  if ("timestamp" %in% names(result)) {
    result <- result %>%
      mutate(timestamp = as.numeric(timestamp)) %>%
      group_by(.data[[img_col]]) %>%
      arrange(timestamp) %>%
      slice_tail(n = 1) %>%
      ungroup()
  }

  result %>%
    transmute(
      participant_id = row$participant_id,
      block          = as.numeric(row$block),
      trial          = as.numeric(row$trial),
      image_name     = .data[[img_col]],
      posX           = grid_col,
      posY           = grid_row
    )
}
```

```{r}
final_placements <- grid_trials %>%
  split(seq(nrow(.))) %>%
  map_dfr(extract_final_placements) %>%
  mutate(trial = as.numeric(trial)) %>%
  filter(trial > 0)
```

# Tag category, set, and base name

```{r}
final_placements <- final_placements %>%
  mutate(
    category = case_when(
      str_detect(image_name, "happy|sad|angry|fearful|surprise|disgust") ~ "emotions",
      str_detect(image_name,
                 "horse|lion|wolf|fish|squirrel|sheep|peacock|pigeon|fox|butterfly|ladybug|dolphin") ~ "animals",
      str_detect(image_name,
                 "tree|flower|grass|leaf|apple|broccoli|blueberry|acorn|cherry|cactus|cabbage|peanut") ~ "plants"
    ),
    set       = str_remove(str_extract(image_name, "_\\d+"), "_"),
    base_name = str_remove(image_name, "_\\d+")
  )
```

# Compute pairwise-distance vector per participant × category × set

```{r}
# Helper: pairwise distance vector from coords (sorted by base_name for alignment)
compute_distance_vector <- function(df) {
  coords <- df %>%
    arrange(base_name) %>%
    select(posX, posY) %>%
    as.matrix()

  dist_matrix <- as.matrix(dist(coords))
  dist_matrix[upper.tri(dist_matrix)]
}

# Collapse to one position per concept per trial.
#   - animals/plants: 1 picture per concept per trial, so mean() is a no-op
#   - emotions: averages the 2 within-trial pictures of each emotion
trial_positions <- final_placements %>%
  group_by(participant_id, category, trial, base_name) %>%
  summarise(
    posX = mean(posX),
    posY = mean(posY),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# One distance vector per (participant × category × trial)
trial_dist <- trial_positions %>%
  group_by(participant_id, category, trial) %>%
  nest() %>%
  mutate(dist_vec = map(data, compute_distance_vector)) %>%
  select(-data)
```

```{r}
# Alternative test-retest for emotions: average over all set pairings
emotion_test_retest_pairings <- final_placements %>%
  filter(category == "emotions") %>%
  group_by(participant_id, trial, set) %>%
  nest() %>%
  mutate(dist_vec = map(data, compute_distance_vector)) %>%
  select(-data) %>%
  group_by(participant_id) %>%
  summarise(
    consistency = {
      # sets {1,2} are in trial 1; sets {3,4} are in trial 2
      t1_sets <- dist_vec[set %in% c("1", "2")]
      t2_sets <- dist_vec[set %in% c("3", "4")]
      if (length(t1_sets) == 0 || length(t2_sets) == 0) NA_real_
      else {
        cors <- as.vector(outer(
          seq_along(t1_sets), seq_along(t2_sets),
          Vectorize(function(i, j) cor(t1_sets[[i]], t2_sets[[j]],
                                       use = "complete.obs"))
        ))
        mean(cors, na.rm = TRUE)
      }
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

# Consistency: mean within-participant correlation across sets

```{r}
consistency_results <- dist_data %>%
  group_by(participant_id, category) %>%
  summarise(
    consistency = if (length(dist_vec) < 2) {
      NA_real_
    } else {
      combs <- combn(seq_along(dist_vec), 2)
      cors  <- apply(combs, 2, function(idx) {
        cor(dist_vec[[idx[1]]], dist_vec[[idx[2]]], use = "complete.obs")
      })
      mean(cors, na.rm = TRUE)
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  )

consistency_results
```

```{r}
final_placements %>%
  group_by(participant_id, category, set) %>%
  summarise(n_images = n_distinct(base_name), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = set, values_from = n_images, names_prefix = "set_") %>%
  filter(set_1 != set_2 | is.na(set_1) | is.na(set_2))
```

```{r}
names(final_placements)
# should include: participant_id, block, trial, image_name, posX, posY, category, set, base_name
```

# Add age and age group

```{r}
#| message: false
# Adjust path if age_sheet.csv lives somewhere other than the project root
age_df <- read_csv("age_sheet.csv") %>%
  mutate(participant_id = as.character(participant_id))

consistency_results <- consistency_results %>%
  left_join(age_df, by = "participant_id") %>%
  mutate(
    age_group = case_when(
      age <= 4 ~ "3–4",
      age <= 6 ~ "5–6",
      age >= 7 ~ "7–8"
    )
  )
```

```{r}
# Sanity check: any participants without an age?
consistency_results %>%
  filter(is.na(age)) %>%
  distinct(participant_id)
```

# Summary table

```{r}
consistency_summary <- consistency_results %>%
  group_by(age_group, category) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_consistency = mean(consistency, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_consistency   = sd(consistency, na.rm = TRUE),
    n                = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

consistency_summary
```

# Plot

```{r}
ggplot(consistency_results,
       aes(x = age_group, y = consistency, fill = category)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x     = "Age Group",
    y     = "Consistency (Correlation)",
    title = "Semantic Arrangement Consistency by Age Group"
  )
```
